venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wed 9/16 (MOD JK).** Net $1,295 vs $1,333 target (97%); food $177; no events; comps $37.10 (2.9%); 37 guests / $35.01 avg. Weather 89/72. JK opened the bar. Quiet start — used the time to deep clean and ABK the space; then a nice flow of regulars and some work groups. Smooth shift. Reminders: check the bottle tree for batches to refill so the opener isn't left low; leftover super-martini garnish prep goes into the kitchen fridge. Kitchen: good communication; stay curious on keeping wing prep levels where they need to be. 86 Herradura blanco & añejo; low cider, low High Noon. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the 'Herradura king' came in with his group and left two bottles of Herradura (placed in the liquor closet).

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wed 9/16 (MOD KK/MD; Chef JMS).** Net $1,918 vs $1,391 target (138%); food $157; comps $19.35 (1% — employee, F&F, industry); 53 guests / $36.19 avg. Hot, sunny, heat advisory. Excellent Wednesday: two happy-hour groups right after opening, steady until 7pm, then the first night of trivia with a healthy crowd — many walk-ins unaware of trivia happily joined. Host was fantastic, stayed for a round and promoted next week to every guest. Drop-offs ~9:30 and ~10:30, slower pace with industry friends until close. Charmer's team stopped by ~8:30 (they were near empty) and were congratulatory on trivia. Kitchen: JMS executed well and was present on the floor. Maintenance: water accumulation near walk-in freezer door; Well 1 soda tap handle. 86 veggie dog, Guinness draft. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: everyone's enthusiasm for the first night of trivia.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wed 9/16 (AM MOD Maggie S, back from vacation; PM MOD Maggie H).** Net $7,588.55 vs $9,155 target (83%); AM/DC $1,226.62, D&C PM $6,361.93, Garden rained out (NA); food $1,967.70; no events; comps $179.55 (2.4%); 184 guests (Tock) / ~$41.24 avg. AM: easy Wednesday setup with some big pops early; fresh cold brew and turmeric iced tea; low on a few iced teas, coffee filters, Proprietors (coffee delivered tomorrow); 86 strawberry syrup, Evergreen. PM: another 6pm pop before calming down; Sam picked up the host shift again. Garden: rained out — expect more nights like this given the forecast. Kitchen: great night, small pop at 6; prep not heavy but several 911s (chantilly, scallop, hot honey, ranch, tarragon jam, creamed spinach, mignonette); low fingerlings, spinach dip; 86 ranch, scallops, creamed spinach. No events tomorrow. Break make-up complete; no incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Maggie S being back.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wed 9/16 (MOD Kyler; Chef Steves).** Net $4,664 vs $4,806 target (97%); beverage $3,956; food $709; retail $0; no events; comps $32.04 (0.7%); 119 guests (Sevenrooms) / $39 avg. Warmish for fall. Very smooth but relatively busy night, bookended by a calm start and easygoing finish — packed at the tail of the first major turn and ~90% full most of the evening; slowed ~10pm to dates and calm threes. Plenty of wine drinkers; two big food orders drove food sales (a 5-top that decided to have dinner, a 4-top that ordered one of everything). Top sellers: Native Lion, Cloudwalk / Crossover Episode (tie), Dramatic Exit / Burner Phone (tie). Door: mellow, sleepier vibe, filling at 8pm, officially full ~9:30 with a few duos waiting ~30 min; mass exodus after 10:45; quiet by 11:30. Notable guests: couple celebrating 10-year anniversary, an 11-top business celebration, Matthew Bellantone (Per Se) on a day off, and again many Seattle/Amazon folks on work trips. No no-shows. Menu count 17/17; breakage 1 DOF. No incidents. (Submitted 9:08am 9/17.)

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wed 9/16 (MOD Julian, Josh; Chef Saleh).** Net $5,302 vs $5,156 target (103%); Marquee $5,302 / food $1,060; Standing Room $0; no events; comps $214 (4.0%); 137 guests / $88.30 avg as reported (note: net ÷ guests = ~$38.70; form date typed as 9/17 but posted 1:18am 9/17 for Wednesday service). Started nice and steady — a handful of guests right at open kept Xavier busy until reinforcements clocked in. Two servers on the floor with Gracy as support, eventually taking over (prepping for her main-roster server debut). An investor joined with friends; Mia returned and reviewed food/drink knowledge. Busy shift, all hands on deck door to floor. Kitchen: two-man band rocking. Maintenance: creepy crawlers still around; wall patches and loose tile next to host stand. 86 manchego. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: seeing everyone hustle during service and prep.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wed 9/16 (MOD Marcus).** Net $11,460 vs $3,431 target (334%) — full-buyout event night: event sales $11,460, Marquee bar / Garden / food reported as $0 (event only); comps $0; 80 guests / ~$143.25 avg (event). Sunny and warm. Kitchen: food was plentiful and all eaten — James did a great job plating and even helped pass. Incredible energy and vibes. Improve: ring in drinks before they're made. Maintenance: curtains. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: meeting Grace Ramirez, a MasterChef NZ judge.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Warm and pleasant, clear, lightly windy
venues.narrative: **MG — Wed 9/16 (AM MOD Franck / Chef Lex; PM MOD James / Chef Drew).** Net $6,464 vs $4,609 target (140%); Bar AM $1,401, Bar PM $4,284, Sun Club $299, Hot Eye $0 (closed Wed); food $2,999; no events; comps $51.85 (0.8%); 117 guests (OpenTable: 0 AM + 117 PM) / ~$55.25 avg. Morning: steady, handled easily by Catie and Tia; a couple of food-tour groups. Evening: great steady night in little waves — started with very low covers but picked up lots of walk-ins and hotel guests hanging out for drinks; Sam and Carla ran hard; bar quiet until ~9:15 (recent trend); new hires improving daily. Sun Club: slow start, vets on business mostly not drinking; banana daiquiri still a hit. Kitchen: steady with a couple of good pops, no lows/86s. Maintenance: ceiling access hatch in Hot Eye hallway hanging open — must be shut before tomorrow's service. No incidents. Favorite moment: rockstar performances building-wide — Estella and Emma at the host stand, Estella Reyes picking up SA quickly; 'going to be a great busy season.'

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wed 9/16 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net $10,300 vs $7,000 target (147%); food $1,619; comps reported as '~$100 in shifties / 330 DNL/SND' (no single total given — left null); 223 guests / $46.80 avg. Weather perfect. (Form date typed as 9/17; posted 1:21am 9/17 for Wednesday service.) 'Casual 10k Wednesday.' Daisy dominated the floor, making it easy for Julian and Alex Day to run food and handle the D&C nuances. Bar team had zero misrings/double makes. Fair amount of industry guests in. Kitchen: Josh & Wes killed it; almost ran out of tartar. Maintenance: downstairs AC on the fritz (UVI aware); glassware needs replacing. Got MOF yellow Chartreuse — moving to reserve N&F going forward. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: Alex Day in the flesh.
